literature_proposed.summary: No published result covers this range uniformly in k. Van Doorn and Tang (2026) prove lpf C(n,k) ≤ n/k for all large k and k² ≤ n ≤ exp(log²k/(20 log log k)) conditionally on Baker–Harman–Pintz, using Konyagin's counting of m near k with n/m near an integer; their method's parameter stops there. Beyond that range the only known constraint is the one every exception satisfies, k⌊n/k⌋ ∣ k! (so n < k! + k), which bounds n for each fixed k but not k. The leaf's extra hypotheses (n/gcd(n,k) prime, k ∤ n) are proved reductions on this graph, not literature. Status: open.
